recipes.name: levels
recipes.caption: Posterior level medians and pointwise intervals on the original temperature scale.

recipes.name: slopes
recipes.caption: Posterior local slopes, scaled by 120 monthly time steps. These are not direct acceleration estimates.

recipes.name: monthly_residual_spread
recipes.caption: Calendar-month SD of normal scores of smoothed PITs. Descriptive in-sample diagnostics; counts and boundary PITs are exported.

recipes.name: residual_dependence
recipes.caption: Exploratory normal-score correlations. These are not posterior estimates of a copula correlation matrix.

recipes.name: monthly_risks
recipes.caption: Posterior median conditional threshold probabilities in the selected month, with pointwise intervals.

recipes.name: qq_scores
recipes.caption: Normal-score QQ plots from smoothed in-sample PITs. Finite plotting scores clip PITs at 1e-10 and 1-1e-10.

recipes.name: forecast_uncertainty
recipes.caption: July predictive observation and latent-location intervals, and their widths. Bands include future state uncertainty.

recipes.name: source_TXn_parameter_traces
recipes.caption: Retained-chain parameter traces and autocorrelations. New reports include initial slopes and physical innovation magnitudes. A placeholder indicates missing draw exports.

recipes.name: source_TNm_pit_qq_residuals
recipes.caption: Pooled TNm smoothed-PIT, QQ, residual-time and serial-ACF diagnostics.

recipes.name: monthly_scales
recipes.caption: Observation scales by calendar month. For evolving scales, each point describes the last observed occurrence of that month; inspect source dates.

recipes.name: annual_forecasts
recipes.caption: Complete-year predictions: day-weighted means for Gaussian summaries, maxima or minima for extreme summaries.
